title: All series
description: Every time series in the prod database. Managed in git (grafana/dashboards/); edits in the UI are overwritten on the next deploy.

panels.title: Forecast station: observed and newest forecast
panels.description: Raw and cleaned level at every station we forecast, and the newest forecast of each model.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(o.valid_at, $__interval), o.series_id AS metric, avg(o.value) AS value
FROM observations o
JOIN series s ON s.id = o.series_id
WHERE s.variable = 'level' AND s.location IN (SELECT DISTINCT station_id FROM forecasts)
  AND $__timeFilter(o.valid_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

SELECT p.valid_at AS time, 'forecast:' || f.model AS metric, p.level_cm AS value
FROM forecast_points p
JOIN (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (station_id, model) id, model
  FROM forecasts
  ORDER BY station_id, model, issued_at DESC
) f ON f.id = p.forecast_id
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: All gauge levels
panels.description: Every observed level series, averaged per pixel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(o.valid_at, $__interval), o.series_id AS metric, avg(o.value) AS value
FROM observations o
JOIN series s ON s.id = o.series_id
WHERE s.variable = 'level' AND $__timeFilter(o.valid_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Observed rain
panels.description: Every observed rain series in mm per hour, averaged per pixel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(o.valid_at, $__interval), o.series_id AS metric, avg(o.value) AS value
FROM observations o
JOIN series s ON s.id = o.series_id
WHERE s.variable = 'rain' AND $__timeFilter(o.valid_at)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Input forecasts, newest run per hour
panels.description: Forecasts from others that the model uses, e.g. ICON-D2 rain. For each hour the value from the newest run.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(valid_at, $__interval), series_id AS metric, avg(value) AS value
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (series_id, valid_at) series_id, valid_at, value
  FROM input_forecasts
  WHERE $__timeFilter(valid_at)
  ORDER BY series_id, valid_at, run_at DESC
) newest
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Freshness
panels.description: Newest value of every series and of our own forecasts. Ignores the time picker.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT s.id AS "Series", coalesce(o.at, f.at) AS "Newest",
  extract(epoch FROM now() - coalesce(o.at, f.at)) AS "Age"
FROM series s
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT valid_at AS at FROM observations WHERE series_id = s.id ORDER BY valid_at DESC LIMIT 1
) o ON true
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT run_at AS at FROM input_forecasts WHERE series_id = s.id ORDER BY run_at DESC LIMIT 1
) f ON true
UNION ALL
SELECT 'forecast:' || station_id || ':' || model, max(issued_at), extract(epoch FROM now() - max(issued_at))
FROM forecasts
GROUP BY station_id, model
ORDER BY 3 DESC
